% =====================================================================
%  English-primary paper template (LuaLaTeX + CSL citations)
%
%  For papers written mainly in English with occasional Japanese (proper
%  nouns, organization names). For Japanese-primary papers use paper/ja/main.tex.
%
%  **Hand-managed.** `octavo new paper <name>` puts it in papers/<name>/, next to the
%  manuscript, and every build copies it into build/latex/<name>/ — so edit the copy under
%  papers/. body.tex / abstract.tex are generated by `octavo build` — do not
%  edit them (overwritten on the next run).
%
%    octavo build <name> --to latex
%    cd build/latex/<name> && latexmk -lualatex main.tex
%
%  Citations are resolved by pandoc --citeproc using the CSL style named in
%  octavo.config.py. **biblatex/biber are not used.** To switch journals:
%
%    octavo csl get modern-language-association
%    'csl': 'modern-language-association',
% =====================================================================
\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}

% ---- LuaLaTeX basics --------------------------------------------------
\usepackage{fontspec}
% \setmainfont{TeX Gyre Termes}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage[english]{babel}

% Occasional CJK text. haranoaji ships with TeX Live, so this does not
% depend on system fonts. Swap [haranoaji] for [noto] or [ipaex] if wanted.
\usepackage[haranoaji]{luatexja-preset}

% ---- Layout -----------------------------------------------------------
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{setspace}
\onehalfspacing
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\section}{\normalfont\large\bfseries}{\thesection}{1em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\normalfont\normalsize\bfseries}{\thesubsection}{1em}{}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\setlist{nosep}

% ---- Tables & figures -------------------------------------------------
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{caption}
\captionsetup{font=small,labelfont=bf,skip=6pt}
\usepackage{float}
\usepackage{adjustbox}

\makeatletter
\g@addto@macro\@floatboxreset{\small}
\makeatother
\let\oldtabular\tabular
\let\endoldtabular\endtabular
\renewenvironment{tabular}{\adjustbox{max width=\linewidth}\bgroup\oldtabular}
                          {\endoldtabular\egroup}

\makeatletter
\newenvironment{tablenotes}
  {\par\vspace{0.6ex}\footnotesize
   \begin{list}{}{\setlength\leftmargin{0pt}\setlength\rightmargin{0pt}%
                  \setlength\labelwidth{0pt}\setlength\labelsep{0pt}%
                  \setlength\itemindent{0pt}\setlength\listparindent{0pt}%
                  \setlength\topsep{0pt}\setlength\parsep{0pt}\setlength\itemsep{2pt}}}
  {\end{list}\par}
\makeatother

\newcommand{\inputtable}[1]{%
  \IfFileExists{#1.tex}{\input{#1}}{%
    \fbox{\parbox{0.8\textwidth}{\centering
      \textbf{MISSING TABLE:} \texttt{\detokenize{#1}.tex}}}}}

% ---- CSL bibliography support ----------------------------------------
\makeatletter
\@ifundefined{CSLReferences}{%
  \newlength{\cslhangindent}\setlength{\cslhangindent}{1.5em}
  \newlength{\csllabelwidth}\setlength{\csllabelwidth}{3em}
  \newenvironment{CSLReferences}[2]
   {\begin{list}{}{%
     \setlength{\itemindent}{0pt}\setlength{\leftmargin}{0pt}\setlength{\parsep}{0pt}
     \ifodd #1 \setlength{\leftmargin}{\cslhangindent}
       \setlength{\itemindent}{-1\cslhangindent}\fi
     \setlength{\itemsep}{#2\baselineskip}}}
   {\end{list}}
  \newcommand{\CSLBlock}[1]{\hfill\break\parbox[t]{\linewidth}{\strut#1\strut}}
  \newcommand{\CSLLeftMargin}[1]{\parbox[t]{\csllabelwidth}{\strut#1\strut}}
  \newcommand{\CSLRightInline}[1]%
    {\parbox[t]{\dimexpr\linewidth-\csllabelwidth\relax}{\strut#1\strut}}
  \newcommand{\CSLIndent}[1]{\hspace{\cslhangindent}#1}
}{}
\makeatother

\providecommand{\poscite}[1]{\texttt{[poscite:#1]}}

% ---- Links (load last) ------------------------------------------------
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{cleveref}

% =====================================================================
% Blind review. flags.tex is rewritten on every build
% (\anonymoustrue / \anonymousfalse); without it, the normal version.
% **Keep this above \title** — using \ifanonymous before \newif declares it
% stops with Undefined control sequence.
\newif\ifanonymous\anonymousfalse
\IfFileExists{flags.tex}{\input{flags}}{}

% Figure, table and equation numbers (by section by default: 2.1).
% octavo build writes crossref.tex every time.
\IfFileExists{crossref.tex}{\input{crossref}}{}

\title{Paper Title}
\ifanonymous
  \author{\normalsize [Author names withheld for blind review]}
\else
  \author{Author Name\\ \small Affiliation\\ \small\texttt{email@example.edu}}
\fi
\date{\today}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
\noindent
\IfFileExists{abstract.tex}{\input{abstract}}{[abstract.tex missing]}
\end{abstract}

\clearpage
% body.tex ends with the References heading and the CSL bibliography.
\input{body}

% \clearpage
% \appendix
% \input{appendix}

\end{document}
